First soft line
continues in the same paragraph.

A line ending in spaces and tabs 	
loses them all, and one ending in a tab		
or a space after one	 
as well, *inside 	
emphasis* or a [link 	
text](https://example.test), and a heading 	
underlined
===

Two spaces after a tab	  
are no hard break, two spaces alone  
are, and a backslash 	\
keeps what stands before it.
